summary: @or-sdk/agents preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately runs the package-local math_init.js under that alternate runtime. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` module (rotated string-array decoder, large hex token dictionary, hex-mangled identifiers) with no corresponding source and no documented purpose. The stated package purpose is a GraphQL/OpenAI agents SDK, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second runtime and execute an obfuscated blob at install time. The launcher itself is also obfuscated, hiding the invocation from Node-focused scanners. The combination — install-time fetch of an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque sibling payload, purpose mismatch, and obfuscation of both loader and payload — is an install-time remote code execution vector on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
